issues.detail: prompt_to_repeat contains '<<xyz의 이야기>>', so repeating the prompt alone satisfies detectable_format:title even if the story has no title. Same in English ('<<story of xyz>>').
Forbidden '감사' (thanks) also matches homonym 監査 (audit, '보안 감사', '감사원'); a formal SSO-fix statement mentioning a security audit false-fails. English 'thanks' has no such collision. Narrow channel.
Forbidden '타다' matches only the dictionary form (and 타다가); natural inflections 타는/탔어요/타고/탈 escape, so a story using 'ride' passes. Near-vacuous versus English 'ride', the base surface form.
Forbidden '할 수' covers only 하다+can; '탈 수 있다', '배울 수 있다' (= can) pass, as does '할수'. English 'can' catches every use. '수 있' would match the modal.
Forbidden '정류장' misses the same-word variant '정류소' (bus stop); the stem '정류' would catch both, per the guideline's stem rule. Narrow false-pass channel.
'Yo' rendered as nonstandard '요우'; Korean rap writes the interjection as Latin 'Yo' or '요'. Latin 'Yo'/'check'/'peace' are not forbidden, so 'Yo, check it' lyrics pass.
prompt_to_repeat contains '<<아메리칸 토닉>>' and one '브랜드', so the repeat alone satisfies title and half of the frequency>=2 count. Same in English.
